player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} udlala umdlalo we-Checkers njenge {color}.
Yenza umendo ngokwesayensi yeqhinga [fileRank fileRank], isib. '[b2c3]' (isazisi a–h, umgca 0–7).
Imithetho eyisiseko:
  • Hamba diagonally phambili ngokwe-1 ukuba kungewona.
  • Bamba ngokuthuka phezu kwenye isithunzi sesitha.
  • Isithunzi siyinkosi ukuba sifikela ekupheleni kwelinye icala.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Akukho njongo yokuthuka ifumanekayo. Sebenzisa [a1b2], isibonelo [b2c3].
